lines.text: Paul planned to visit Corinth on his way to Macedonia, return from Macedonia, and then be sent on toward Galatia.
Jesus Christ was proclaimed among them, and all of God's promises are "Yes" in Him.
God placed His seal on us and put His Spirit in our hearts as a pledge.
Paul wrote through many tears, out of great distress, to show the Corinthians how much he hated them.
Paul forgave in the presence of Titus, so that Satan would not outwit them.
